text.tspan: Graph-based inversion anchoring attitudes at LC peaks,
connecting via optimized bridges, finding lowest-cost paths.

g.text: 1M -> 50 per peak (150 candidates total, truth injected at idx 0)

text.tspan: At peaks dB/dt ~ 0 so brightness gradient g
is perpendicular to angular velocity omega.
Lo-fi misses shadow effects -> wrong ranking.
Block 5: Build Path Graph & Shortest Path
Sort by total cost -> ranked path list
Lo-fi cannot discriminate the correct path.
Block 6: Rescore Bridges with Hi-Fi Model
Recompute bridge costs -> rebuild graph -> re-rank
(q0 at Peak1, omega_leg1, q at Peak2, omega_leg2, q at Peak3)
Success: att_error < 5 deg AND omega_error < 0.1 deg/s

g.text: Shared Forward Model (used by all evaluation blocks)
